//fixture-design: The query 'derived index invariant' anchors on ANCHOR.md (community 1). Three CANDIDATE files carry records that base-rank as an exact 3-way TIE (identical bodies): CENTRAL.md is GOD-NODE central (highest edge degree) AND shares the query anchor's community 1; RELATED.md is connected to the anchor by a semantically_similar_to INFERRED edge AND co-member of community 1; ISOLATED.md is a node with NO edges in a DIFFERENT community (0) — graph-isolated from the query anchor. The graph term must lift CENTRAL and RELATED above ISOLATED, flipping the base stable-order winner (ISOLATED) to LAST. Records join to nodes by source_file (file-level), never by graph id.
